items.title: A reflective subcategory of an abelian category is abelian
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file homology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that an additive category carrying an additive right adjoint which is left exact into an abelian category, whose composite with that adjoint is isomorphic to the identity, is itself abelian (statement lines 1878-1889). The proof is a complete argument: exactness of the left adjoint transfers kernels and cokernels from the abelian category, using that every morphism of the source arises under the composite (proof lines 1892-1915); the resulting existence of finite limits and colimits makes the right adjoint left exact (proof lines 1916-1923); and the author compares the coimage and the image of a morphism, expressed through the transferred kernels and cokernels, to obtain the last axiom (proof lines 1924-1957). The non-formal content is the transfer of kernels and cokernels and the comparison of coimage and image. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
